stage: C3X 0.9.0-G10-P17 — Prospective Preference-Preservation Susceptibility Field, Pre-Edit Pair-Margin×Cross-Engine Agreement×Relation-Atom×Collateral Geometry, Structural-Chain Survival Modeling, Outcome-Blind Intervention-Admissibility Score, Leave-Source-Out Calibration, Hard-Regime Abstention, Fresh Balanced-Ecology Validation & Preference-Stable Counterfactual Acquisition Experiment
question: Which pre-edit chess/search and structural-chain properties transparently identify whether a legal counterfactual chain will preserve the frozen A/B preference relation, and can an interpretable abstention policy prospectively enrich preference-stable interventions on repo-unseen balanced sources?

forbidden_authority_models: post-hoc surrogate of an opaque predictor
black_box_firewall.optional_baseline: No opaque baseline is required. If added later, it is falsifier-only and can never select features, thresholds, policy, or scientific verdict.
black_box_firewall.explanation_requirement: Every score/admission decision must decompose into named feature bins, integer contributions or ordered rules, and an explicit abstention reason.

development_data.unit: unique position × structural chain signature from P16 ROUTED/GLOBAL_G2 validation worlds
development_data.outcome: preference-supported on TARGET/SUBSET/SHAM for at least two frozen active engines
development_data.duplicate_rule: If ROUTED and GLOBAL_G2 choose the same chain signature on one position, deduplicate before fitting/evaluation.

position_pair: gap_dispersion_cp = max(active engine gap)-min(active engine gap)

transparent_families.form: integer additive points over frozen categorical/binned features
transparent_families.fit_rule: exhaustive/branch-and-bound on one development source only; tie-break fewer terms, smaller L1, lexical feature order
transparent_families.trace: list every nonzero term and contribution

transparent_families.fit_rule: greedy on one development source with minimum rule support 3; tie-break precision then support then lexical
transparent_families.trace: first fired rule or explicit default abstain

transparent_families.form: at most two predeclared two-way interaction tables plus one main-effect table
transparent_families.fit_rule: empirical Laplace-smoothed cell survival from one development source; no hidden representation

leave_source_out.model_selection: For each family, fit independently in each fold. A family is eligible only if its admission rule is identical under the frozen tie-break grammar across both training arms OR differs only in numeric integer coefficients while feature/rule structure is identical.
leave_source_out.selection: First family in T1→T3 meeting every gate; no post-hoc feature additions.

hard_regime_abstention.principle: No pressure to cover every chess context. If transparent evidence does not clear the frozen admission threshold, ABSTAIN is the scientifically correct action.

confirmation_firewall.balanced_acquisition: reuse P16 routed-domain chess ecology where possible, but score/admission may not use source identity
confirmation_firewall.chain_generation: enumerate frozen G0-G4 structural chains; susceptibility policy selects/abstains before edited-board engine outcomes

required_surface: explicit statement that admissibility is not objective chess truth or a causal certificate
